**[high, correctness]** — Fixed in `dontpanic_orchestrate/outcome_score.py:1232`. `_pair_locked_with_live` no longer runs an "undrifted (method AND capability) first" pass; within an identity group it now runs capability-first passes: (1) capability *and* method, (2) capability alone, (3) live order. Capability is strictly the primary key, so the auditor's alpha/beta case can no longer fall through to live order — I replayed their probe verbatim and it now pairs `alpha↔alpha`, `beta↔beta` and reports the real drift, `proof method changed after lock (walk → named_test)` / `(named_test → walk)`, instead of a phantom capability edit.
